result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mainly around contrast and clipping/overlay behavior. The page is generally usable, but some elements look unfinished or partially hidden.

issues.description: The promotional banner text has very low contrast: white text is placed on a very pale mint background, making the heading and subtitle hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text, darken the banner background, or add a stronger overlay so the promo message meets contrast requirements.

issues.description: The bottom navigation appears to overlap the restaurant content. The lower popular item is partially hidden behind the fixed tab bar, which makes the card feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: A partial empty category pill is visible on the far right of the category row, which looks like a broken or blank filter chip.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scrolling/spacing so the next chip shows some label text, or clip it cleanly at the edge.

issues.description: Horizontal restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' section are heavily cropped at the right edge, including the restaurant name, which may look visually broken if not clearly intended as a carousel.
issues.suggestion: Show a bit more of the next card with consistent spacing, or add a clearer horizontal-scroll affordance.
